app.title: kagami
screen.waitingHint: Open kagami on your Mac or phone and enter this code
screen.stalled: Connection stalled — generating a new code…
mediaError.network: network error while loading the video
mediaError.decode: the file seems corrupt or truncated
mediaError.unsupported: unsupported format, unsupported codec, or the URL isn't reachable
sender.castUrlInvalid: Only http:// and https:// links are supported
sender.castUrlIsPage: That's a {site} page, not a direct video file — kagami can't cast it as-is.
sender.castUrlIsPageYoutube: That's a YouTube page, not a direct video file — kagami can't cast it as-is. If your TV has YouTube's own app, use that instead.
sender.castUnsupportedContainer: You picked a .{ext} file — kagami's cast supports: {formats}. Convert it or pick a different file.
sender.castSeekMayNotWork: This file's index sits at the end and couldn't be optimized — seeking may not work reliably.
sender.audioSourceHint: This browser can't capture system audio directly — pick an input device fed by a virtual audio device (e.g. BlackHole) to send system sound
sender.audioPermissionNeeded: Microphone permission is needed to list input devices
sender.audioPermissionDenied: Microphone permission denied — enable it in this site's settings
sender.audioNoDevices: No input devices found — plug one in (or enable a virtual device like BlackHole) and retry
sender.aspectHint.auto: whole screen, black bars if needed
sender.aspectHint.expanded: fills the TV, crops the edges
sender.aspectHint.16:9: stretches the image to this format
sender.aspectHint.21:9: stretches the image to this format
sender.aspectHint.4:3: stretches the image to this format
sender.braveWarning: Brave may block screen encoding entirely here — try disabling Shields for this site
sender.safariNote: Safari captures the screen at half resolution and can't record system audio — Chrome with VP8 gives the best result
sender.chromeH264Warning: Chrome's H.264 encoder is broken on Apple Silicon (measured ~3fps) — VP8 is recommended
sender.h264AspectWarning: Codec is H.264 — on TVs with hardware decoding, aspect modes have no visible effect (the TV's own video overlay ignores the page's CSS); only "expanded" matches reality. Measured on an LG OLED — switch to VP8 for the other modes to work.
sender.bitrateExceedsWarning: Sending more than the network can currently handle
sender.joinError.room-not-found: That code doesn't exist or already expired
sender.joinError.room-full: That screen already has a sender
sender.iosBody: iOS doesn't let any browser capture the system screen — that's AirPlay's exclusive. Paste a video link below to cast it to the TV instead.
sender.drmNotice: Netflix, Prime, Disney+ and similar show a black screen when mirrored — that's DRM working as intended, not a bug. Use the TV's own app for those instead.
sender.shareFailed: Couldn't start sharing — did you cancel the picker?
sender.qualityUnsupported: That quality isn't supported here — try a lower preset
sender.codecUnsupported: This browser doesn't offer H.264 or VP8 for screen sharing — the TV can't decode anything else. Try Safari.
